# Review of revised vetoes 4 and 5

2026-10-21, Europe/Warsaw. All 355 previously vetoed books were reviewed individually. No titles were added from outside the existing source collection. Earlier analyses remain historical records.

V4 allows substantiated, balanced expert speculation with explicit safeguards. V5 requires religious doctrine or specifically evidenced advocacy of ideological extremism. Manifesto labels, activism, criticism and proposed reforms are insufficient. Each review also checks book form, fiction, instruction/reference purpose and V1–V3 independently; removing a veto does not establish a new one.

**185 works restored; 169 remain vetoed; 1 become hard-excluded.** Current ledgers: 2776 recommended, 169 vetoed, 904 excluded. Uncertain findings carry explicit confidence. Poor fit remains scored and is not an exclusion.
